note: Autonomous new-book production is OFF. 38 live ebooks, 30 of them with no royalties, and five titles blocked by Amazon: the constraint is acquisition, not supply. Enforced by new_book_gate.py, not by convention.
how_to_open: Set autonomous_new_books true AND one of the two doors true, then add the concept under 'concepts' with all six evidence fields filled. Both are owner decisions.
independent_of: the KDP freeze, which blocks publishing regardless of this gate. An open gate means a book may be researched or written, never that it may be uploaded.
